texto: Learning Interest Rate Interpolation was presented at Research in Options 2018 (the event honours Bruno Dupire's 60th birthday). This work was inspired by Bruno's "Theoretical Skew" (also referred to as "Breakeven Volatilities") and describes how to learn the correct interpolation for interest rates by replication. I also (briefly) discuss learning Black&Scholes and similar optimal hedging strategies.
